dsDescriptionValue.value:
The RDN contains 4 regions (Enschede, Rotterdam, Tilburg, Zaanstreek) where demographic behaviour has been collected from the population registers for two cohorts (1881-'85 en 1911-'15)

Please use the tree view to get an overview of the file structure. The dataset can best be downloaded as a whole to keep the original file structure intact.

datasetVersion.citation: Mandemakers, Kees, 2026, "Regionale verschillen demografisch gedrag Nederland 1900-1960 (RDN)", https://doi.org/10.34894/ULFRVX, DataverseNL, V1
